collection.description: After a demanding delivery, a father is offered his newborn.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After a demanding delivery, (name1), a father, is offered his newborn. He has imagined this moment many times, yet the small, warm weight in his arms feels entirely new.

choices.label: Ask His Partner to Hold the Baby First

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The child settles against his chest, and he cries with relief.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: His hands tremble, so the healer helps him find a secure hold.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: He watches them meet, then reaches for his child.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: His partner hesitates, surprised; they share a nervous laugh.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: After a little sleep, he greets his child with fresh attention.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: He feels disappointed to wait, and the healer reassures him that rest is reasonable.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The baby quiets briefly at his voice.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The baby keeps wailing, and he speaks gently anyway.
